text: Widget Makers Europe welcomes the proposal. In Article 5(1), providers shall keep technical logs for at least six months after placing the widget on the market. A shorter period would leave incidents untraceable.
Consumer Watch disagrees with the logging duty. Providers should not be required to keep technical logs for any fixed period, because logs expose user data.

Position of the City Network.

In Article 9(2), replace 'shall' with 'may': the authority may publish the assessment where publication serves the public interest.
Acme supports a transition period. Small providers need at least twelve months before Article 5 applies.
Providers shall keep technical logs for at least six months after placing the widget on the market.
Label Alliance asks that Article 3 require the energy grade to be printed in a font no smaller than the product name.
